events.text: Expobank CZ was founded.
events.subject: self
events.quote: founded in 1991

events.text: Igor Kim became the majority shareholder and owner.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 2014 , the Russian entrepreneur Igor Kim has been the majority shareholder and owner

events.text: The bank was established as a Swiss-Hungarian joint venture under the name InterBank, akciová společnost.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The original bank was established in 1991 as a Swiss-Hungarian joint venture under the name InterBank

events.text: The bank obtained a banking license.
events.subject: self
events.quote: obtained a banking license on 28.12.1991

events.text: The current valid license was received under the name Interbanka, akciová společnost.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was received under the name Interbanka , akciová společnost ( joint-stock company ) on 13 . 2 . 2004

events.text: The license was supplemented.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was supplemented on 6.5.2005

events.text: A number of changes in the shareholder structure took place.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Between 1993 and 1997 a number of changes in the shareholder structure took place

events.text: The transition period of shareholder structure changes stabilized.
events.subject: self
events.quote: this transition period stabilized at the end of 1997

events.text: Bayerische Landesbank became the majority shareholder.
events.subject: self
events.quote: at the end of 1997 , when the German Bayerische Landesbank became the majority shareholder

events.text: Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank (MKB) and BAWAG became minority shareholders.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Hungarian Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank ( MKB ) and the Austrian Bank für Arbeit und Wirtschaft AG ( BAWAG ) became minority shareholders

events.text: BAWAG became the sole shareholder of Interbank a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 2003 , BAWAG became the sole shareholder of Interbank a.s .

events.text: The bank was renamed BAWAG Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in June 2004 the bank was renamed BAWAG Bank CZ a.s .

events.text: BAWAG acquired 100% of the shares of Dresdner Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 2004 , BAWAG acquired 100% of the shares of another bank on the

events.text: Dresdner Bank CZ a.s. was founded as a joint venture of BNP and Dresdner Bank AG.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Dresdner Bank CZ a.s . was founded in 1991 as a joint venture of the French Banque National de Paris ( BNP , later BNP Paribas ) and the German Dresdner Bank AG

events.text: Under the original name BNP-Dresdner Bank (ČSFR) a.s. it obtained a banking license.
events.subject: self
events.quote: under the original name BNP-Dresdner Bank ( ČSFR ) a.s . obtained a banking license on 3.9.1991

events.text: Dresdner Bank AG became the sole shareholder of the bank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2001 Dresdner Bank AG became the sole shareholder of the bank

events.text: The bank was given a new license under the name Dresdner Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: under the name Dresdner Bank CZ a.s . on 4.11.2003

events.text: Dresdner Bank CZ a.s. was renamed BAWAG International Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Dresdner Bank CZ a.s . was renamed BAWAG International Bank CZ a.s .

events.text: Dresdner Bank CZ a.s. ceased to exist as a result of the merger with BAWAG Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: ceased to exist on 31 March 2005 as a result of the merger with BAWAG Bank CZ a.s .

events.text: LBBW became the sole shareholder and BAWAG Bank CZ a.s. was renamed LBBW Bank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 2008 , another change occurred when German Landesbank Baden-Württemberg ( LBBW ) became the sole shareholder and BAWAG Bank CZ a.s . was renamed LBBW Bank CZ a.s .

events.text: LBBW agreed to sell LBBW Bank CZ to the Russian bank Expobank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In January 2014 , LBBW agreed to sell LBBW Bank CZ to the Russian bank Expobank owned by the entrepreneur Igor Kim .

events.text: The branch network was reduced.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the end of November 2014 , the branch network has been reduced .

events.text: Igor Kim became the majority owner of the Czech bank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since the end of 2014 , Igor Kim has been the majority owner of the Czech bank .

events.text: The business name of the bank was changed to Expobank CZ a.s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 15 . 10 . 2014 the business name of the bank was changed to Expobank CZ a.s .

events.text: Expobank CZ a.s. repurchased EAST Portfolio, s.r.o. and acquired a 100% stake from LBBW.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 2016 , Expobank CZ a.s . repurchased EAST Portfolio , s.r.o . in which it acquired a 100% stake from the German LBBW .

events.text: Expobank CZ a.s. was the first Czech bank to enter the Serbian market and became the sole shareholder of Marfin Bank a.d. Beograd.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 2017 Expobank CZ a.s . was the first Czech bank to enter the Serbian market , where it became the sole shareholder of Marfin Bank a.d . Beograd .

events.text: Expobank announced the opening of its Cryptocurrency trading and investing services.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 2018 , Expobank announced the opening of its Cryptocurrency trading and investing services .

events.text: Expobank CZ has been based in the Trimaran building on Na strži street in Prague's Pankrác district.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since April 2019 , Expobank CZ has been based in the Trimaran building

events.text: A branch located on Wenceslas Square in Prague moved to the neighboring City Element building in Prague's Pankrác.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 2019 , a branch that had been located on Wenceslas Square in Prague moved to the neighboring City Element building
